title: leaves the quarantined tests out of the required e2e job
why: The required suite runs the quarantined tests again: a test known to be flaky blocks every merge, and quarantine takes nothing off the critical path.

title: runs only the quarantined tests in a job that passes where there are none
why: Playwright exits with an error when its filter matches nothing, so the quarantine job would fail on every run in which no test is tagged, which is the usual state.
